lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model A: input output and notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Study both examples. The second one drops some of the wording of the first.

steps: Substitute x = 5 into the rule: f(5) = 3(5) + 4.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 2x - 3, find the value of x for which f(x) = 11.

steps: Set the rule equal to the target output: 2x - 3 = 11.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
Function B is given by f(x) = x + 10. Function A is given by the table:
x: 0, 1
y: 8, 12
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = x - 4. Function A starts at 2 and increases by 1 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 0?
choices: The two functions have equal values at that input.
Cannot be determined without a graph.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: -1, 3, 7, 11
y: -4, 8, 20, 32
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
choices: cannot be determined from a table

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Classify the equation y = x + 1 as linear or nonlinear.
choices: cannot be determined from an equation

items.prompt: A function contains the points (-1, 12) and (-5, 32). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.
A rental company charges a $37 base fee plus $38 per hour. Which function models the total cost f(x) for x hours?
A kettle of water heats up steadily, then boils at a constant temperature, then cools steadily once removed from heat. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
choices: decreasing at a constant rate the whole time
increasing at a constant rate the whole time

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 6, height goes from 9 to 9.
From t = 6 to t = 9, height goes from 9 to 14.
From t = 9 to t = 12, height goes from 14 to 6.
Which interval shows the height increasing?
Consider the relation {(-3, 2), (-2, 7), (4, 2), (8, 4)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Yes, this relation is a function.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.
It is a function only if every output is different.
No, this relation is not a function.
